title: opencode
description: opencode 1.19.0 — web UI for AI agent tasks (anomalyco/opencode). Renders to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (mode 0600). The `opencode` slot is the single config block. Verified against the upstream JSON Schema at https://opencode.ai/config.json (draft 2020-12) and against the 1.19.0 binary's own config normalizer, which migrates every key marked `deprecated` below into its modern replacement. Upstream's `$defs`/`$ref` graph is inlined here — the platform's resolver is single-file and does not follow `$ref`. NOTE: 1.19.0 has both a legacy and a modern provider shape; prefer the modern one. `provider` is still accepted (migrated on load) but `enabled_providers`, `disabled_providers`, `small_model` and `subagent_depth` are carried by the binary without being migrated, so they silently have no effect.

opencode.description: opencode config block (the body of opencode.json).

$schema.description: JSON Schema pointer for editor completion. Written verbatim into opencode.json.

provider.description: LEGACY provider map, keyed by provider id. 1.19.0 still accepts this — the binary's normalizer folds it into `providers` on load — but upstream marks it deprecated and it will be removed. Prefer `providers` for new configs. Note the field names differ between the two shapes: `npm` here vs `package`, `options` here vs `settings`. The form renders this as a 'pick provider + fill options' widget driven by `x-provider-choices` (server-stamped from manifest.configs[].supported_providers).

api.description: API adapter for models under this provider.

name.description: Display name shown for this provider in the opencode UI. opencode matches this against the name used in `/connect`.

id.description: Canonical provider id this entry routes to.

env.description: Environment variable names to read for this provider's credentials, in priority order.

npm.description: NPM package implementing this provider's SDK. An OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint uses `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`.

whitelist.description: Model ids to expose from this provider.

blacklist.description: Model ids to hide from this provider.

options.description: Provider connection settings. The modern form calls this `settings`.

apiKey.description: API key for the provider. Auto-injected from the bound virtual key at deploy time — leave the placeholder; the deploy service substitutes the real key.

baseURL.description: Provider endpoint base URL. Must include the `/v1` suffix for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL, for copilot authentication.

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false).

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider, or `false` to disable.

headerTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for response headers (default 300000), or `false` to disable.

chunkTimeout.description: Milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks (default 300000), or `false` to disable.

models.description: Models this provider serves, keyed by model id. opencode cannot discover models from an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so each id the proxy serves is declared here — against a LiteLLM proxy the key is LiteLLM's `model_name` alias, not the vendor's model name.

name.description: Display name in the opencode model picker.

family.description: Model family, used to group variants and pick prompt overlays.

release_date.description: Release date (YYYY-MM-DD). Lets opencode tell known models from unknown custom ones.

attachment.description: Whether the model accepts image attachments.

reasoning.description: Whether the model supports reasoning/thinking controls.

temperature.description: Whether a temperature parameter is accepted.

tool_call.description: Whether the model supports tool calls.

experimental.description: Hide from the picker unless experimental features are enabled.

variants.description: Named variants of this model (typically reasoning-effort levels), selectable as `<model>#<variant>`.

cost.description: Pricing info, either a token-cost object or a lookup id.

modalities.description: Input/output modalities. opencode reads modalities from its built-in registry, not from a custom endpoint's /models — declare `input: ["image"]` here or image attachments are silently dropped.

providers.description: Provider map, keyed by provider id. This is the current form, and the target the legacy `provider` map is migrated into. Field names differ from the legacy shape: `package` (not `npm`), `settings` (not `options`), `modelID`/`releaseDate` in camelCase. Upstream sets additionalProperties:false on this shape, but this schema stays permissive so power users can add provider-plugin fields in raw mode.

canonical.description: Canonical provider id this entry routes to. Use to alias a custom endpoint onto another vendor's model namespace.

name.description: Display name shown for this provider in the opencode UI. opencode matches this against the name used in `/connect`.

env.description: Environment variable names to read for this provider's credentials, in priority order.

package.description: NPM package implementing this provider's SDK. An OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint uses `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`.

compatibility.description: Payload-shaping flags for providers whose wire format deviates from what the adapter assumes.

reasoningField.description: Field carrying the reasoning payload, when the provider's differs from the adapter default.

cacheFormat.description: Prompt-cache wire format the provider expects.

settings.description: Provider connection and runtime settings. This is where `baseURL` and `apiKey` live in the modern form.

baseURL.description: Provider endpoint base URL. Must include the `/v1` suffix for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

apiKey.description: API key. Auto-injected from the bound virtual key at deploy time — leave the placeholder.

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL, for copilot authentication.

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false).

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider, or `false` to disable.

headerTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for response headers (default 300000), or `false` to disable.

chunkTimeout.description: Milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks (default 300000), or `false` to disable.

compaction.description: Context-compaction strategy for this provider: `{type: "summary"}` (openclaw does the summarizing) or `{type: "native"}` (delegate to the provider).

headers.description: Static headers merged into every request to this provider.

body.description: Extra JSON merged into every request body.

models.description: Models this provider serves, keyed by model id. Must be declared for a custom endpoint — opencode cannot discover it.

modelID.description: Model id as the provider knows it. Normally the map key is the id, so this is redundant; set it only when they differ.

name.description: Display name in the opencode model picker.

family.description: Model family, used to group variants and pick prompt overlays.

releaseDate.description: Release date (YYYY-MM-DD). camelCase here; the legacy form uses `release_date`.

cost.description: Pricing info, either a token-cost object or a lookup id.

limit.description: Context window and output budget. Declare these for a custom endpoint so opencode does not guess from the model name.

capabilities.description: Declared model capabilities, including input modalities. Declare image input here or attachments are silently dropped for a custom endpoint.

variants.description: Named variants (typically reasoning-effort levels), selectable as `<model>#<variant>`.

disabled.description: Hide this model from the picker without deleting the entry.

model.description: Default model, used when no session or agent model is selected. Either a `<providerId>/<modelId>` string (optionally `#<variant>`), or an object naming the parts explicitly.

oneOf.description: Model ref as `<providerId>/<modelId>`, optionally `#<variant>`. The provider id is a key of `providers` (or legacy `provider`); the model id is a key of that provider's `models`.

model.description: Model id — a key of that provider's `models`.

variant.description: Reasoning-effort variant, as declared under that model's `variants`.

default_agent.description: Agent to select when a session starts. Matches an entry under `agents`.

agents.description: Named agent configurations, keyed by agent name. Current form; supersedes the legacy `agent` map.

model.description: Model this agent uses. Same `<providerId>/<modelId>` string form as the top-level `model`.

variant.description: Reasoning-effort variant appended to the model ref.

description.description: One-line description shown in the agent picker.

mode.description: Agent role. `primary` agents are offered directly; `subagent` agents are only invoked by other agents. The binary stamps `mode: "primary"` onto entries migrated from the legacy top-level `agent` map.

disable.description: Disable specific tools for this agent.

permission.description: Per-agent permission overrides, same shape as the legacy top-level `permission` map.

agent.description: LEGACY agent map. Migrated into `agents` on load, with `mode: "primary"` stamped on each entry; deprecated upstream.

permissions.description: Tool permission rules. Current form; the binary flattens both the legacy `permission` map and the legacy `tools` map into this rule list on load.

action.description: What the rule governs — e.g. 'edit' (the legacy map's 'write' and 'patch' both normalize to this), or '*' for a blanket rule.

resource.description: Glob the rule applies to, e.g. '*' or a path pattern.

permission.description: LEGACY permission map (tool action -> effect, or tool -> resource -> effect). Flattened into `permissions` on load; deprecated upstream.

tools.description: LEGACY tool enable/disable map. Flattened into `permissions` on load; deprecated upstream.

snapshots.description: Enable session snapshots, letting the workspace state be reverted. Current key; `snapshot` is the deprecated alias.

snapshot.description: LEGACY alias for `snapshots`. Deprecated upstream; migrated on load.

share.description: Session sharing mode. The legacy boolean `autoshare: true` migrates to `share: "auto"`.

update.description: Auto-update behavior: `true` updates silently, `false` disables, `notify` shows a banner. Current replacement for the deprecated `autoupdate`.

autoupdate.description: LEGACY auto-update behavior. Deprecated upstream; use `update`.

enabled_providers.description: LEGACY allow-list of provider ids. Deprecated upstream and NOT migrated by the 1.19.0 binary — it has no effect. Declared only so existing configs still validate; drop it and rely on the `provider`/`providers` map alone.

disabled_providers.description: LEGACY deny-list of provider ids. Deprecated upstream and NOT migrated by the 1.19.0 binary — it has no effect. Remove the provider entry from `provider`/`providers` instead.

small_model.description: LEGACY smaller/faster model for lightweight tasks. Deprecated upstream and NOT migrated by the 1.19.0 binary — it has no effect. Use a per-agent `model` instead.

subagent_depth.description: LEGACY sub-agent nesting depth limit. Deprecated upstream and NOT migrated by the 1.19.0 binary — it has no effect.

logLevel.description: LEGACY log verbosity. Deprecated upstream. NOTE: 1.19.0 exposes no replacement key in its schema — `logLevel` is carried for existing configs but marked deprecated, so leave it unset unless the user explicitly asks for it.

username.description: Display name shown in the opencode UI.

shell.description: Shell binary used for command execution (e.g. '/bin/bash').

instructions.description: System instructions appended to the default prompt.

commands.description: Custom slash commands. Migrated from the deprecated `command` key.

references.description: Reference documents made available to the agent. Migrated from the deprecated `reference` key.

tool_output.description: How tool output is truncated / retained.

plugins.description: Plugin specs — a package name, or a `[package, options]` pair. Migrated from the deprecated singular `plugin` key.

skills.description: Skill sources: local paths and/or URLs. The binary flattens this into a plain path list on load.

layout.description: LEGACY TUI layout overrides. Deprecated upstream.

attachment.description: LEGACY attachment settings. Deprecated upstream; migrated to the current shape.

autoshare.description: LEGACY boolean alias for `share`. `true` migrates to `share: "auto"`; deprecated upstream.

command.description: LEGACY custom slash commands. Migrated into `commands` on load; deprecated upstream.

mode.description: LEGACY agent map (new agents carrying `mode: "primary"`). Merged into `agents` on load; deprecated upstream.

plugin.description: LEGACY singular plugin list. Migrated into `plugins` on load; deprecated upstream.

reference.description: LEGACY reference documents. Migrated into `references` on load; deprecated upstream.
